source_field: PartyNo (IsInlineBranch=1)
source_meaning: One of the 4 inline-branch parties 02/03/04/05 (an own location)
transformation: branchCode = leading 2 chars of FirmName (02,03,04,05). Do NOT import the mirror parties (ClientAs_ToBranch=1 with Inline_ToBranchNo) as Branches or Clients.
validation: 4 rows in; 0 mirror rows in Branch/Client; branchCode unique per company
gap_or_decision: D13 (05 has no name; branch inventory)

source_field: BranchNo IS NULL (and BookMaster.BranchNo IS NULL)
source_meaning: Implicit head office / 'Self' location (no party row exists for it)
transformation: One extra Branch row for HO; every NULL BranchNo and NULL Book branch resolves to it
validation: count of source rows with NULL branch = count of target rows on the HO branch (per object type)
gap_or_decision: D13 (owner must confirm NULL=HO and the HO name/code)

source_field: AccGst on branch parties (2 distinct values across 4 parties; 1 empty)
source_meaning: Branch GST registrations
transformation: Create registrations first, then link each Branch; never reuse one registration for a branch GATI books under a different GSTIN
validation: each GATI sale lands on the same GSTIN GATI used
gap_or_decision: D13, D20 (which branch uses which GSTIN is not provable from counts)

source_field: BookNo, BookName, BranchNo, BookTranType, BookPrefix
source_meaning: Per-branch document books; a document's branch = its book's branch
transformation: Resolve each document's branch through its book, never through its party
validation: 0 documents with an unresolved book

source_field: PartyNo (IsCustomer=1; 7,318 rows)
source_meaning: Customer / dealer / branch-counterpart master key
target_field: (no source-key column exists) clientCode generated; legacy key must be preserved
transformation: Create one Client per customer party; EXCLUDE mirror branch parties
validation: count by IsCustomer = count of Clients (minus excluded mirrors)

source_field: FirmName, LegalName, AccGst, FirmPan, FirmAdd1-3, FirmCity, FirmState, FirmPinCode, FirmTele, OwnerMobile, FirmEmail, CreditLimit, IsBlackList
source_meaning: Identity, contact, tax identity, credit limit, blocked flag
target_field: name, gstNumber, panNumber, address/city/state/pincode, phone, email, creditLimit, isActive
transformation: Copy; trim; validate GSTIN with shared/gstin.ts before storing; IsBlackList -> isActive=false is a proposal only
validation: GSTIN checksum pass-rate reported; PAN/Form 60 flagged for >2,00,000 rule
gap_or_decision: D26 (PII handling; type mapping; blacklist semantics)

source_field: IsSupplier=1 (272 rows)
source_meaning: Supplier master
target_field: supplierCode generated, name, gstNumber, panNumber, bank fields, isComposition=false
transformation: Create Supplier per party; isComposition unknown in GATI
validation: count match

source_field: IsSalesMan=1 (190 rows); JewelTrans.SalesPersonNo
source_meaning: Sales person (a party, not a login)
transformation: No TRIVO login exists for these; either create users/memberships or keep a text snapshot
validation: every historic invoice keeps its sales person identity

source_field: IsAccount=1 (198 rows)
source_meaning: Ledger accounts live in the party table
transformation: Map GATI account parties onto the Starter Package chart; unmapped ones need a new Account
validation: every journal side maps to exactly one Account or one party sub-ledger

source_field: GrpNo, SubItmNo (142 / 742 rows)
source_meaning: Category / sub-category
transformation: Copy, preserve source codes; link sub-category to category
validation: row counts; every tag's category resolves

source_field: StockTypeNo (5 rows: STOCK ORDER, CUSTOMER ORDER, REPAIR, ORDER, CUSTOMER REPAIR)
source_meaning: Stock type (35,139 of 35,384 tips are STOCK ORDER)
validation: every tag's stock type resolves

source_field: MakeTypeNo (12 rows: GLD, DIA, SLV, PLT, CZ, POLKI, KUNDAN, ANTIQUE, NAKSHI, ITALIAN, BEADS, SILVER GIFT ARTICLES)
source_meaning: Make type
transformation: TRIVO's makeType drives the MakingCharge master lookup; the GATI list mixes metal (GLD/SLV/PLT) with style (POLKI/KUNDAN...) so a straight copy may break MC matching
validation: MC lookup succeeds for every migrated tag

source_field: BaseMetalId -> ItemCode (SL925, G22KT, G18KT, G14KT, SL999, G999; 258 tips none)
source_meaning: Base metal + purity
transformation: G22KT->22K, G18KT->18K, G14KT->14K, G999->999 gold, SL925/SL999 -> silver purity; KaratMaster must contain the target code first
validation: tag counts and net metal weight by (metal, karat) match
gap_or_decision: D25 (253 HO available tips with no metal, 78,432 g gross; what are they?)

source_meaning: HSN codes
transformation: HsnCode is shared statutory data; rate comes from TRIVO master, never from GATI
validation: every historical InvoiceItem.hsnCode resolves

source_field: CommonMasterId (83 rows: brand, gender, size, hallmark)
source_meaning: Brand / gender / size / hallmark option lists
transformation: Only the ones actually on tags (Inward.BrandNo/ItemSizeId/HallMarkId); gender/brand have no TRIVO home
validation: n/a

source_field: JewelCode
source_meaning: Printed tag / barcode number; shared along a transfer chain (35,384 distinct for 59,839 rows)
transformation: Preserve exactly; ONE JewelryTag per JewelCode, built from the chain tip (NewJewelId IS NULL)
validation: distinct JewelCode = count of JewelryTag; tagNumber collisions 0

source_field: JewelId, NewJewelId, InwardType
source_meaning: Per-instance key; next instance; R/W/I/T origin
transformation: Every superseded instance maps to the same tag as its tip; hop order from NewJewelId
history_handling: Chain preserved as movement history, not as tags
validation: 59,839 JewelId in map = 35,384 tags

source_field: Status (with NewJewelId)
source_meaning: A available, X sold, V issued to another branch, C on approval, I retag/repair source, T split
transformation: Tip-only: A->IN_STOCK, X->SOLD, C->ON_APPROVAL, V(tip, no clone)->TRANSFERRED only if D15 says in transit, I/T per D16. Superseded V/I rows are not tags.
validation: count of tips by GATI status = count of tags by mapped status; no tag lands in a status by default
gap_or_decision: D15, D16 (owner sign-off on each letter)

source_field: BranchNo (+ BookMaster.BranchNo of the issuing document for a V tip)
source_meaning: Current branch of the instance
transformation: NULL -> HO. A transferred-but-unreceived (V) tip keeps its SOURCE branch (TRIVO changes branchId only at receipt)
history_handling: branch per hop in movement history
validation: tips by branch (incl. HO) match; 0 tags without a branch

source_field: GrossWt, NetWt, NetWtNotBase, TotDiaWt, TotCDiaWt, TotCZWt, TotImiWt, TotOthMtlWt
source_meaning: Gross weight; base-metal net; other-metal net; stone weights
transformation: grossWeight = GrossWt; netWeight = NetWt (base metal) [+ NetWtNotBase only if D22 says]; stoneWeight = sum of stone weights (carat vs gram basis to be confirmed)
validation: sum of gross and net by branch/metal/karat within tolerance in the reconciliation plan

source_field: COST, ActualCost, Tot*CostAmt, InwardDetail.CostAmount/CostRate/FinalCostAmt
source_meaning: Cost and its components. 'COST' equals the sum of the component cost columns within 1 rupee for 57,572 of 58,417 tags with COST>0; 845 do not; 1,422 tips have COST=0
target_field: costPrice (immutable in TRIVO), costMcRate, costVaPercent, material costRate/costAmount
transformation: Take the ORIGINAL (R instance) cost, not the transfer-repriced clone cost (2,520 of 24,177 clones differ from their source). Exact field choice and treatment of zero/unexplained rows are decisions.
validation: sum(costPrice) by branch/metal = sum(COST of chosen instance); every exception listed

source_field: Id, JewelId, JewelTransId, BookNo, Trans, Jstatus, InOutType, TransactionDate, isLastTransaction (183,583 rows)
source_meaning: Derived movement ledger; no location column (LocationId always NULL)
target_field: TagHistory is written only by a database trigger and cannot be loaded
transformation: Needs a new import-only movement table or a controlled trigger exception; chain order by TransactionDate then Id
history_handling: This IS the history to keep
validation: per tag: last InOut=1 row Jstatus = mapped status; 0 mismatches expected (GATI's own check shows 0)

source_field: ItemId, Pieces, NetWeight, Rate, Amount, CostRate, CostAmount, IsBase, SizeNo (95,952 rows)
source_meaning: Material rows (metal / stone) of a tag
target_field: code, materialType, pieces, weight, costRate, costAmount, saleRate, saleAmount
transformation: ItemId -> MaterialCode via the item master; IsBase marks the metal row
validation: row count per tag; weight and amount sums per tag

source_field: MRP, ActualMRP, LandingMRP
source_meaning: Priced selling value (a stored result of GATI's formula)
transformation: TRIVO re-prices live from the daily metal rate and tagged MC/VA; a copied MRP is a reference, not a rate source. saleMcRate / saleVaPercent have no direct GATI column (formulas in InwardFormula).
validation: documented as informational

source_field: Jewelry_CertificateNo, HallMarkId, InwardExploration (HUID?)
source_meaning: Certificate / hallmark identity
transformation: Locate the real HUID column before mapping (not proven)
validation: HUID uniqueness and format

source_field: InwardQty, ItemPieces, Remarks, MiscRemarks
source_meaning: Quantity, pieces, remarks
transformation: Copy
validation: n/a

source_field: EntryBy, EntryDate, UpdateBy, UpdateDate
source_meaning: Creator / editor user ids and times
transformation: GATI user ids need a user map; TRIVO createdAt defaults to now and tag_history stamps import time
history_handling: TagHistory CREATED event will show the import time
validation: user map complete

source_field: BagId, PO_OrderId, PO_OrderItemId, OrderProceedItemId, StockAssignPartyNo, Order_*
source_meaning: Manufacturing / order links
transformation: Out of scope: no tag carries a bag, manufacturing order or stock-assign link in the data checked
validation: assert 0 non-NULL on migrated tags

source_field: ImageName, ImageExt, STLImageName
source_meaning: Image file references
transformation: Images live on the GATI file share (D:\GATISOFTTECH\SJEP IMAGE); not migrated in this scope
validation: n/a

source_field: TranType='JWSL' (8,180 docs; books 37, 1121, 1180, 2226 = Tax Invoice)
source_meaning: Sales invoice
target_field: invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, clientId, branchId, salesPersonId, subtotal, discountAmount, otherCharges, taxAmount, roundOff, totalAmount, paidAmount, balanceDue, status, notes
transformation: GATI JewelTransPrefix+JewelTransNo is the number already filed in GST returns and printed on invoices; TRIVO's sequence cannot be supplied. status derived from settlements.
history_handling: tagging the sold tip via line link
validation: sum(totalAmount) by month and branch = sum(JewelTrans.Amount); count of docs

source_field: TranType='JWSL' books 36 and 1124 ('Estimate Invoice', 110 + 17 docs); JWSR books 1107, 2227 ('Estimate Sale Returns')
source_meaning: Estimate / non-tax bills (nature not proven)
transformation: Do not create a TaxInvoice or GST liability until D33 says what these are
validation: excluded from GST reconciliation until classified

source_field: TranType='JWSL' BookNo=98 'Jewelry Purchase Return (SP)' (117 docs, 513 lines, all tags X)
source_meaning: Purchase returns recorded as sales documents
evidence: C (doc type) / H (counterparty is a supplier)
transformation: Map to PurchaseReturn, NOT SalesInvoice. TRIVO's createPurchaseReturn accepts GRN-sourced tags only; these tags have no GRN.
validation: excluded from sales totals; 117 docs counted separately

source_field: JewelTransId, JewelId, SrNo, HSNId, MRP, DiscountAmt, OriginalSaleId (68,395 rows)
source_meaning: Document lines
target_field: tagId, productCode, description, quantity, weights, hsnCodeId, taxRate, unitPrice, totalPrice, materialBreakdown
transformation: The sold line's tag = the tag of that instance's JewelCode (M031). Per-line GST in GATI is not stored; allocate the document-level GST to lines proportionally (TRIVO stores per-line tax).
validation: sum of line totals = document gross within rounding; each tagId resolves

source_field: ASrNo -> AdSetupDetail.SrNo for the doc's JewelTrans.AdSetUpNo (e.g. 1.5% SGST, 1.5% CGST, 3% IGST, ADD, Round Off, Discount); 48,495 rows
source_meaning: Document-level add/less incl. GST. ASrNo numbering differs per AdSetUpNo (18 setups on JWSL docs)
transformation: Always resolve through (JewelTrans.AdSetUpNo, ASrNo); never read a bare ASrNo
validation: sum(CGST+SGST+IGST) = sum(taxAmount); 117 JWSL docs have AdSetUpNo NULL

source_field: RawNo, QlyPurity, Rate (78,871); MetalRateDate
source_meaning: Per-document metal rate snapshot
transformation: Copy as a snapshot; never re-price an imported invoice
validation: invoice totals unchanged by import

source_field: PlaceOfSupply, IsGSTRegistered, IsLUT, PartyNo
source_meaning: Place of supply, registration flags
transformation: Resolve via StateMaster
validation: CGST+SGST vs IGST split equals GATI's per document

source_field: TranType='JWSR' (128 docs, 153 lines); OriginalSaleId (153/153 resolves to a JWSL doc and the same tag)
source_meaning: Sale return referencing the original sale
transformation: SalesReturn requires the original invoice and invoice item; both available. Returned tag reuses the same JewelId (no new 'N' tag in this DB).
history_handling: tag back to A (IN_STOCK) per history
validation: every return line has a resolvable invoice item; return totals tie
gap_or_decision: G7 (credit note / GST reversal not wired in createSalesReturn: I3), D20

source_field: TranType='JWAP' (109 docs; 6,348 lines; books 6, 1133, 1176, 2221); history 'PJWAP' = approval return
source_meaning: Approval / memo out and its return
target_field: memoNumber, clientId, sentDate, returnDeadline, status, items.tagId
transformation: Only open memos (136 C tips) are stock-relevant; closed memos are history. returnDeadline has no GATI field.
validation: 136 open memo tips = open MemoItems

source_field: TranType='BJWSL' (783 docs, 24,389 lines) and 'BJWPH' (741 docs, 24,175 lines)
source_meaning: Branch issue and branch receive; receive clones the tag
target_field: transferNumber, fromBranchId, toBranchId, status, dispatchedAt, receivedAt, items.receivedAt
transformation: One BranchTransfer per BJWSL document; item receivedAt = clone creation; items with no clone = in transit (212). TRIVO mutates ONE tag in place; GATI clones.
validation: 24,177 completed items + 212 outstanding = 24,389 lines

source_field: TranType IN ('BJWSL','BJWPH') (783 + 741 rows; ₹3,334.7M / ₹3,270.5M)
source_meaning: Inter-branch transfer postings
transformation: TRIVO transfers post no journal. Importing them would create inter-branch balances TRIVO would not reproduce; omitting changes per-account totals
validation: reconcile with and without

source_field: DrAccountNo, CrAccountNo, Amount, Jdate, TranType, TransactionId, TransNo, TransPrefix, DocNo, SettlementId (46,814 rows)
source_meaning: One row = one Dr/Cr pair; source link via TranType + TransactionId (JWSL/BJWSL/BJWPH/JWSR/JWPH -> JewelTrans; VCH/JRN -> VoucherEntry; MPH/MSL partly)
transformation: Group rows by (TranType, TransactionId) into one balanced entry; or take balances only (D18). Never replay through postAutoJournalEntry (it posts its own).
validation: sum Dr = sum Cr per entry; total by account by month = GATI

source_field: SettlementId, Journal_Id, Amount, Dr/CrAccountNo (46,915 rows; Settlement 14,737)
source_meaning: Allocation of receipts/payments to journal rows; Journal.SettlementId is NULL on every row
transformation: Allocation to a specific invoice is only inferable through the journal row's TransactionId
validation: paidAmount per invoice = sum of allocations

source_field: VoucherEntryId, TransactionAs, PartyNo, Amount, ModeOfPayment, BookAccountNo (12,678 / 4,183)
source_meaning: Receipts, payments, journal vouchers
transformation: Voucher kind decides the target; kinds not yet profiled
validation: count and amount per voucher kind

source_field: DueId, PartyNo, TransactionId, BookNo, DueAmt, DueDate (12,227 rows; includes BJWSL/BJWPH and MPH)
source_meaning: Bill-wise open items. Does NOT tie to journal net per party (181 of 6,889 agree); settlement-adjusted it still does not
transformation: Do not use as the balance source; use only as a cross-check once the authoritative report is known
validation: explained difference per party

source_field: CompCode, PartyNo, AccDebit, AccCredit, StartComp (VASD0001 all zero; VASD0002 Dr=Cr=₹1,017.8M, 247 non-zero rows)
source_meaning: Opening balances per company/FY code; VASD0002 equals the FY1 journal closing for 1,831 of 1,859 comparable parties
transformation: Balances are CARRIED, not new money; compute cutover balance from journals, compare to AccountBalance
validation: 28 differing parties explained or signed off

source_field: TranType 'MPH' (2,228), 'MSL' (557), SPM_MaterialTrans, SPM_MaterialStock (3,579)
source_meaning: Raw metal purchase / sale and metal stock
transformation: Whether the Metal Vault is in scope has not been decided
validation: metal weight by karat tie to GATI stock

source_field: InwardType='I' (278), Status 'I' (278), StockType REPAIR/CUSTOMER REPAIR
source_meaning: Retag / inward-repair chains (same JewelCode, same branch)
transformation: If these are retags TRIVO's TagRetag could hold them; otherwise they are just chain hops
validation: 278 source rows map to 278 hops

source_meaning: Add/edit/delete log with no document content; semantics unreliable
transformation: Archive the GATI log outside TRIVO; write one IMPORT audit entry per batch
validation: batch audit entries exist

source_meaning: Past stock-takes (no location recorded)
transformation: Low value; branch not recorded so cannot map to a TRIVO branch audit safely
validation: n/a
